questions.sourceFile: 精品解析：2024年上海市金山区中考二模英语试题（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: The book on the desk can’t be Julia’s. ________ has been lent to Mary.
questions.topicReason: 空格作主语，指代 Julia 的书，需用名词性物主代词 Hers。

questions.sourceFile: 精品解析：2024年上海市长宁区中考二模英语试题（含听力）（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: John is old enough to dress ________ now. His mother doesn’t have to help him.
questions.topicReason: dress oneself 表示“自己穿衣服”，主语 John 对应反身代词 himself。

questions.sourceFile: 精品解析：2024年上海市闵行区中考二模英语试题（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: “Boys and girls, whatever you’re doing, just do ________ best.” said our class teacher.
questions.topicReason: do one’s best 为固定表达，此处需形容词性物主代词 your。

questions.sourceFile: 精品解析：2024年上海市黄浦区中考二模英语试题（解析版）.docx
questions.prompt: Later, I found out that the young man was an old friend of ________.
questions.topicReason: a friend of mine为双重所有格，考查名词性物主代词。

questions.sourceFile: 2025上海初三英语二模16区试卷.pdf
questions.prompt: The students in Class 5 will have a young lady to teach ________ English this term.
questions.topicReason: 考查teach后宾语代词形式，需区分人称代词宾格、物主代词和反身代词。

questions.sourceFile: 2025上海初三英语二模16区试卷.pdf
questions.prompt: The teacher praised ________ after he completed the project ahead of schedule.
questions.topicReason: 考查人称代词宾格与反身代词辨析；主宾同指时用 himself。

questions.sourceFile: 2025上海初三英语二模16区试卷.pdf
questions.prompt: David was proud to present a painting of ________ own at the art gallery last week.
questions.topicReason: of his own 中 his 为物主代词，考查人称/物主代词用法。

questions.sourceFile: 2025上海初三英语二模16区试卷.pdf
questions.prompt: - Where did you get the toy car? - Come on, we made it ________ .
questions.topicReason: 考查 make it ourselves 中反身代词表示“我们自己做”。

questions.sourceFile: 2025上海初三英语二模16区试卷.pdf
questions.prompt: Our goals may be similar, but it seems ________ methods are more efficient.
questions.topicReason: 考查形容词性物主代词 your 修饰名词 methods。

questions.sourceFile: 2025上海初三英语二模16区试卷.pdf
questions.prompt: We sometimes call Lin Lin Lily. That’s ________ pen name she uses when she writes poems.
questions.topicReason: 考查形容词性物主代词her修饰名词pen name。

questions.sourceFile: 2025上海初三英语二模16区试卷.pdf
questions.prompt: To save ________ from wildfires, we need to follow safety rules and leave quickly.
questions.topicReason: save ourselves 表示拯救我们自己，考查反身代词。

questions.sourceFile: 2025上海初三英语二模16区试卷.pdf
questions.prompt: Nowadays I can choose online courses and study by _______. Sometimes I can ask DeepSeek.
questions.topicReason: study by oneself 表示“自学”，考查反身代词 myself 的用法。

questions.sourceFile: 【英语官方解析】精品解析：上海市奉贤区2025-2026学年九年级下学期二模英语试卷（解析版）.pdf
questions.prompt: Delivery companies make it easy for ________ to shop online.
questions.topicReason: 介词 for 后用人称代词宾格，we 的宾格形式为 us。

questions.sourceFile: 【英语官方解析】上海市虹口区2026年下学期九年级中考二模 英语试卷（解析版）.pdf
questions.prompt: The retired couple have decided to move to Kunming. It’s time for ________ to begin a new life.
questions.topicReason: 介词for后用人称代词宾格them，指代the retired couple。

questions.sourceFile: 【英语官方解析】上海市黄浦区2026年九年级中考二模英语试卷（解析版）.pdf
questions.prompt: Zheng won ________ first international gold medal in women’s singles at the age of 13.
questions.topicReason: 修饰名词 medal 需要形容词性物主代词 her。

questions.sourceFile: 【英语官方解析】精品解析：上海市金山区2026年九年级下学期中考二模英语试卷（解析版）.pdf
questions.prompt: This umbrella is not ________. I think you’ve taken the wrong one.
questions.topicReason: 考查名词性物主代词：This umbrella is not yours，相当于 not your umbrella。

questions.sourceFile: 【英语官方解析】精品解析：上海市闵行区2025-2026学年九年级下学期学业质量抽样调研（二模）英语试卷（解析版）.pdf
questions.prompt: The most popular slogan on the internet this year is “We should love ________”.
questions.topicReason: 考查反身代词：主语we与宾语指同一群体，用 ourselves。

questions.sourceFile: 【英语参考答案】2026年上海初三松江二模英语参考答案【含解析】.pdf
questions.prompt: During the winter holiday, Joe taught ________ to play the guitar with the help of online videos.
questions.topicReason: 考查反身代词：teach oneself to do sth.表示自学做某事。

questions.sourceFile: 【英语官方答案】2026年上海市徐汇区中考二模考试英语试题（解析版）.pdf
questions.prompt: My brother suggested that a friend of ________ should help me find a part-time job.
questions.topicReason: 考查双重所有格结构：a friend of his表示他的一个朋友。

questions.sourceFile: 【英语官方解析】2026年上海市杨浦区中考英语二模试卷（解析版）.pdf
questions.prompt: This old hiking map might serve ________ well if we get lost in the mountains.
questions.topicReason: serve 后接宾格人称代词作宾语，应为 us。
